**Chinese name:** 东芯半导体股份有限公司 (Dōngxīn Gǔfèn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A two-story firm: a niche-memory designer riding the 2025-26 shortage to 67.7% gross margin and H1 2026 net profit ¥6.59亿 (vs FY2025 loss) — with an interim dividend of ¥6/10 shares plus a bonus issue — and a listed proxy for Lisuan's consumer GPU incubation (¥0.42亿 equity-method loss H1, ~65% of RTX-3060 gaming performance per independent tests). The 7G100 sold through its ¥2,688 JD retail launch from 16 July and became the first Chinese GPU maker to exhibit standalone at ChinaJoy (July–August); Lisuan's next-gen architecture is in design with no tape-out date given, and Dosilicon says it holds no current integration of its own memory on Lisuan's GPUs. If the 7G100 scales, the off-balance-sheet GPU template becomes the model for design houses nurturing advanced logic.
:::

## What does this firm design?

SLC/MLC NAND, NOR, niche DRAM and MCP/eMMC combos; affiliate's 6nm graphics GPUs.
